output.question: Who is Accenture's CTO?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Accenture’s Chief Technology Officer is Dr. Marc Warner. ([accenture.com](https://www.accenture.com/en/about/leadership/marc-warner)) He assumed the role on March 16, 2026, when Accenture completed its acquisition of Faculty. ([newsroom.accenture.com](https://newsroom.accenture.com/news/2026/accenture-completes-acquisition-of-faculty))

key_facts.fact: Dr. Marc Warner is Accenture’s Global Chief Technology Officer.
Warner assumed the CTO role upon completion of Accenture’s acquisition of Faculty on March 16, 2026.
